summary.text: Reed Olson is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 2A, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Executive director of the Nameless Coalition for the Homeless, he previously ran for the seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Olson was born in St. Cloud and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-Madison in 1998, according to Ballotpedia.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a cook, small business owner and community nonprofit director.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as executive director of the Nameless Coalition for the Homeless.

Olson lost the 2022 general election for District 2A to incumbent Republican Matthew Grossell, and Ballotpedia's campaign finance records also show a 2022 candidacy for Minnesota's 7th Congressional District that ended with a withdrawal before the primary, and a loss in the 2024 general election for District 2A.
In his 2022 survey, he said he would support policies to create more housing in rural Minnesota, support people starting child care businesses, and increase investment in mental health services.
